from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import tempfile

source = Path('/data/ycfeng/tmp/glm53_dsv4/profile02_results_readonly_7ba56n6z/artifacts/nodes/gpu-h800-0216.host.platform.shaipower.com/serving_profile/rank0.before_profile.json')
out = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='native_capture_scope_root_', dir='/data/ycfeng/tmp/glm53_dsv4'))
raw = source.read_bytes()
artifact = json.loads(raw)
rows = artifact['annotations']
capture = [row for row in rows if row.get('execution') == 'capture']
stream = [row for row in capture if row.get('stream_capturing') is True]
breakable = [row for row in capture if row.get('breakable_capture_active') is True]
both = [row for row in stream if row.get('breakable_capture_active') is True]
nonbreakable = [row for row in stream if row.get('breakable_capture_active') is False]
result = {
    'source': str(source),
    'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
    'bytes': len(raw),
    'python': sys.version.split()[0],
    'capture_annotations': len(capture),
    'capture_stream_true': len(stream),
    'capture_breakable_true': len(breakable),
    'capture_both_true': len(both),
    'capture_stream_true_breakable_false': len(nonbreakable),
    'capture_scopes': dict(Counter(row['scope'] for row in capture)),
    'stream_capture_scopes': dict(Counter(row['scope'] for row in stream)),
    'nonbreakable_stream_capture_scopes': dict(Counter(row['scope'] for row in nonbreakable)),
    'stream_capture_layer_max': max(row['layer'] for row in stream if row.get('layer') is not None),
    'stream_capture_graph_modes': dict(Counter(str(row.get('graph_mode')) for row in stream)),
    'replay_eager_scopes': dict(Counter(row['scope'] for row in rows if row.get('execution') == 'replay_eager_segment')),
    'serving_dispatch_scopes': dict(Counter(row['scope'] for row in rows if row.get('kind') == 'serving' and row['scope'].startswith('model_dispatch_'))),
    'dropped': artifact.get('dropped'),
    'context': artifact.get('context'),
    'scope': 'One retained profile02 decode rank0 startup artifact; no native stack execution or node-owner join.',
    'script_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
result['checks'] = {
    'capture_annotations': result['capture_annotations'] == 159748,
    'capture_stream_true': result['capture_stream_true'] == 72798,
    'capture_breakable_true': result['capture_breakable_true'] == 49035,
    'stream_capture_layer_max': result['stream_capture_layer_max'] == 42,
    'all_capture_scopes': len(result['capture_scopes']) == 31,
}
result['status'] = ('PASS_LIMITED_CAPTURE_ANNOTATION_CENSUS' if all(result['checks'].values())
                    else 'FAIL_LIMITED_CAPTURE_ANNOTATION_CENSUS')
(out / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
print('OUTPUT', out)
assert all(result['checks'].values()), result['checks']
